Design: Use one Preparation tab with saved-profile selection, editable position/preparation title, company/platform, skill focus and requirements. Reuse existing dark field/button styles and margins. Screenshot review at 1440 and approximately 390 pixels is required after implementation.

Keep profiles local, preserve existing prompts/provider settings, validate IDs/strings and ensure only the selected preparation enters answer context. Verify through persistence and prompt-flow tests.
